data.narrative:
Poolside is a Series B-stage AI & Software company founded by Jason Warner and Eiso Kant that has raised $626M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of three same-sector, same-stage comparables: Scale AI ($29.0B), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B), and Black Forest Labs ($3.2B), supplemented by a broader universe of nine private and one public AI infrastructure peer (Palantir).

Two valuation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses the $626M total raised as a proxy for post-money valuation and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B progression, yielding $1.2B. The peer-median approach leverages the three same-stage, same-sector comparables, which have a median valuation of $5.6B, a minimum of $3.2B, and a maximum of $29.0B. This method produces an implied value of $5.6B.

The triangulated range is $1.0B to $6.4B, with a median of $3.4B across both methods. The wide dispersion between methods reflects meaningful uncertainty around Poolside's positioning within the Series B frontier-tech cohort. The stage-progression method assumes raised capital as a floor and applies mechanical multiples; the peer-median method anchors to observable market valuations but depends on the representativeness of the three comparables selected. Resolution of this gap requires clarity on Poolside's product differentiation, customer traction, and relative burn profile versus the peer set.
